description: Search theatre, musicals, concerts, comedy and other live events on sale on TIX in Australia and New Zealand, including discounted Lasttix deals. Returns titles, cities, dates, AUD from prices, discounts and the TIX show page URL. Filters combine; with no filters it returns what is on now and coming up, soonest first.

deals.description: Only shows with a discounted Lasttix deal.

when.description: In the city's time zone (Sydney when no city).
